semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippo Precision provides specialized measurement equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing and quality control.
summary: Nippo Precision specializes in providing advanced measurement systems for the semiconductor industry, focusing on non-destructive and non-contact electrical property measurement for wafers. Their products are integral to ensuring the quality and uniformity of semiconductor materials.
capabilities: Non-destructive electrical property measurement for 4-inch and 6-inch wafers
